note: Researched supplier sets for the Compare tab, one per speciality. HUMAN-CURATED — no automation writes this file. Until 05/08/2026 these lived hard-coded inside app/comptab.js, which meant adding a speciality was a code change to a file that also holds the tab's rendering; there were two, and eleven specialities carried notices. Moving them here makes growth a data edit that verify.py can gate. app/comptab.js still holds vascular and continence as a baked fallback so the tab is never empty if this file cannot be fetched; anything here overrides it.
sourceRule: Every framework name, its dates and its supplier list come from that framework's own contract launch brief on supplychain.nhs.uk, fetched directly. Brand names come from the NHS Supply Chain online catalogue entry for the supplier's own NPC codes — the procurement record, not the supplier's marketing. Nothing here is inferred from a trade summary or a comparison table.

bloodcoll.label: Blood collection / phlebotomy

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Blood Collection Devices (1 lot, 19 suppliers, 9 of them new)

bloodcoll.routeNote: One lot covering the whole category. It replaced and combined the former Blood Collection Systems and Blood Lancets framework and the Blood Culture Collection Systems framework, so a trust's incumbent may sit on it under a different arrangement than the one they remember. Blood collection is nested under Vascular access in the Hub's speciality list because the same accounts touch both — but the buyer is usually pathology or phlebotomy, not the vascular access team.

suppliers.note: Incumbent across most of the category. KFK036, its multi-sampling adaptor, is on Protect Demand Management — see live issues.
KFK232 Luer multisampling adaptor and the Vacuette Quickshield safety tube holder (450230). Named in ICN 3385 as an alternative to BD's KFK036.

Not a like-for-like swap: Sarstedt's own page describes S-Monovette drawing by aspiration ("the plunger rod is gently pulled") as well as by vacuum, so moving to it changes technique and training, not just a code. Holds four of the seven codes in the adaptor section (KCM096, KCM114, KCM128, FNG85313).
FNG85289 multi-sampling Luer adaptor holder, named in ICN 3385 as an alternative; also the SOL-CARE single-use safety tube holder (BCA019).
KFK978 sampling Luer adaptor, named in ICN 3385 as an alternative, plus the Prosum sterile sampling cap holder (BCH002).
Awarded on the framework; lancets and capillary sampling rather than venous tubes.
One of the nine suppliers new to this framework at the 2025 award.
Awarded on the framework; also on both vascular access frameworks, so often already a known name in the account.

cardiology.label: Cardiology

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Electrodes, Ultrasound Gels, Defibrillation and Related Consumables (9 lots, 37 suppliers). Lot 8 is Defibrillation Electrodes and Pads

cardiology.routeNote: Nine lots: ultrasound gels, adult ECG electrodes, paediatric/neonatal ECG electrodes, neurology electrodes and needles, pre-wired electrodes, foetal scalp electrodes, abdominal CTG belts, defibrillation electrodes and pads, and related consumables. Defibrillation pads are Lot 8. The set below is the defibrillation and ECG electrode players, not all 37 awarded suppliers.

suppliers.note: Own-brand pads for its own defibrillators: FBH85027 adult and FBH85028 paediatric multifunction electrodes for AED Plus / R Series / X Series, FDJ1736 and FDJ1737 OneStep. The direct alternative wherever a trust runs Zoll and buys third-party pads.
Distributes Leonhard Lang's Skintact range. FDK317 and FDK049 carry an open field safety notice — see live issues. Not a recall.
Lifepak edge adult pads (FDJ3862) and defibrillation device batteries. The other large installed base alongside Zoll.
PadPro adult transparent pads with a Zoll connector (FDJ85057) — a like-for-like route for a Zoll fleet.
Distributes Telic. The widest connector coverage on the catalogue — separate codes for Zoll-M&B, Schiller, Philips/HP, Physio-Control/Medtronic-Mindray and GE fits, adult and paediatric.
Awarded on the framework; strongest in ECG electrodes.
Own-brand pads for its own defibrillator estate.
Awarded on the framework; contract manufacturer as well as own-brand, so often behind another label.
Own-brand consumables for its own monitoring and defibrillator estate.

skin-prep.label: Skin prep and antisepsis

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Skin Cleansing, Disinfection and Hygiene (6 lots, 29 suppliers). Lot 5 is Skin Disinfectant (Medicinal Products), Lot 6 is Pre-operative Skin Preparation

skin-prep.routeNote: Six lots: patient cleansing wipes, waterless bathing, personal care, antimicrobial cleansing, skin disinfectant (medicinal products) and pre-operative skin preparation. The set below is the skin-antisepsis players, not all 29 awarded suppliers. Note that a 2% chlorhexidine / 70% alcohol applicator is a licensed medicinal product, so it sits in Lot 5 rather than with the wipes.

suppliers.note: The incumbent in 2% CHG / 70% alcohol applicators, and the origin of the whole chlorhexidine thread — a sterility recall plus a separate production-line supply issue. See live issues.
The nearest like-for-like to ChloraPrep on the catalogue: DEC85019 swabstick, DEC85017 26ml and DEC85034 10.5ml applicators. Now capped by Protect Demand Management itself — see live issues.
GAMA's own site describes HEXI as "2% CHG in 70% IPA solutions for intravenous care" — the same formulation as ChloraPrep, from a supplier not caught by either notice.
Bottled solutions DEC85071 (tinted) and DEC85072 (clear). Also the cannulation packs whose 13 codes are suspended because ChloraPrep is a component — see live issues.

The widest bottled chlorhexidine range on the catalogue: DEC85002 500ml clear, DEC85023 200ml, DEC85027 200ml red-staining ready-to-apply, plus 0.5% sprays. A bottle is a different infection-control conversation from a single-use applicator.
Hibiwash 500ml (4% chlorhexidine gluconate) carries its own Class 2 medicines recall — filed under Matched to a tracked product, not here.
Octenidine rather than chlorhexidine, so unaffected by the CHG supply pressure — worth knowing when a trust is rationed.
Awarded on the framework; patient cleansing and hygiene rather than pre-operative antisepsis.

infection.routeNote: Examination gloves only. Surgical gloves sit on a separate framework, and hand hygiene on another again — so a glove conversation and a hand-hygiene conversation are two different buying routes even when they are the same infection prevention lead.

Restore and SensiCare nitrile across the FTE86 series, non-sterile and sterile.
Accelerator-free nitrile (GM0052 series).

anaesthesia.label: Anaesthesia and critical care

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Anaesthesia Machines, Ventilators, Neonatal Equipment and Phototherapy Systems, Related Accessories and Services (4 lots, 25 suppliers, 8 of them new)

anaesthesia.routeNote: Capital equipment and its accessories and services, in four lots: anaesthesia machines, ventilators, neonatal equipment and phototherapy. Long replacement cycles and a service tail, so the conversation is usually fleet-level and multi-year rather than consumable-by-consumable. Airway management consumables sit on a separate framework.

suppliers.note: All three model families are named on Dräger's own UK hospital page. Atlan workstations carry an open MHRA alert on ventilator motor failure — see live issues.
Awarded on the framework; one of the two other large anaesthesia workstation estates in UK theatres.
UK manufacturer of anaesthesia machines; awarded on the framework.

Ventilation specialist; awarded on the framework.

respiratory.label: Respiratory

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Respiratory Solutions (6 lots, 37 suppliers). Lot 5 is Diagnostics

respiratory.routeNote: Six lots: oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, respiratory therapy, anaesthesia and resuscitation, diagnostics, and sterile water for humidification. Incentive spirometers are ward-level respiratory therapy — the people who feel a shortage are physiotherapy and enhanced recovery, not procurement.

suppliers.note: Holds both volume incentive spirometers on the catalogue (FDK6925, FDK6926) — and both are suspended. See live issues.
UK manufacturer with the broadest respiratory consumable range on the framework.
Humidification and high-flow oxygen therapy.
Northern Ireland manufacturer; breathing circuits and oxygen therapy.
Welsh manufacturer; airway and respiratory consumables.
Diagnostic spirometry (Lot 5) rather than incentive spirometry — a different product doing a different job, worth being precise about in a conversation.
Awarded on this framework and on the electrodes and defibrillation framework.
Nebuliser and aerosol therapy specialist.
Holds the other six codes in the catalogue's Spirometer section — all flow sensors and waterlocks for its own machines, not incentive spirometers.

renal.label: Renal and dialysis

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Renal Replacement Therapies Services, Technologies and Consumables (5 lots, 25 suppliers)

renal.routeNote: Five lots: dialysis consumables and equipment, home dialysis service, home peritoneal dialysis service, continuous renal replacement and plasma therapies, and managed service. Much of this category is bought as a service rather than a product, so the decision sits with the renal unit and the ICB together, and contracts run long.

suppliers.note: The largest presence across the framework. Its balance peritoneal dialysis solution carries a Class 4 medicines defect notification — labelling only, nothing recalled. See live issues.
The former Baxter kidney care business, now a separate company — worth knowing, because an account may still call it Baxter.
Awarded on the framework; also on the vascular access and infusion frameworks.
Awarded on this framework and on Blood Collection Devices.
Dialysis access and procedure packs; also on the vascular access framework.
Awarded on the framework (two entities, Belgium and Germany).
Awarded on the framework; continuous renal replacement.

bloodtx.label: Blood and transfusion

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Infusion Pumps and Administration Sets and Associated Products (4 lots, 27 suppliers). Lot 3 is Gravity Administration Sets, where blood giving sets sit

bloodtx.routeNote: ⚠ This framework expires 30/09/2026, so any tender conversation now is really a conversation about its successor — check the procurement calendar before quoting it. Derived, and stated so you can judge it: all seven manufacturers named in MHRA alert DSI/2026/003 (B Braun, Baxter, Becton Dickinson, CODAN, Fannin, GBUK and RPG Medical) appear on this framework's own award list, which is why it is filed as the route to market for transfusion giving sets. The brief itself does not name blood transfusion sets in a lot.
